prompts.title: Η κλήση του Αβραάμ και η πορεία της υποσχέσεως
prompts.prompt: Create one finished educational theological illustration, widescreen 16:9, mature visual language suitable for Greek secondary education from Gymnasium through final Lyceum. Neo-Byzantine painted illustration: disciplined clear forms, dignified faces, luminous gold and warm earth pigments, deep blue accents, subtle mineral-pigment texture, sophisticated balanced composition. Full bleed, no border, no written words, no labels, no lettering, no watermark. Carefully distinguish all people and limbs. The scene must communicate the specified lesson concept and stand alone at small screen size. Use case: historical-scene. Main request: Abraham and Sarah begin their journey of trust in God's promise, walking together from their homeland toward the land of Canaan. Two mature ancient Near Eastern adults wearing modest ancient robes, carrying simple travel bundles, leading a single pack animal on a winding path across an expansive ancient Near Eastern landscape. Sarah is equally visible beside Abraham. The path leads toward a broad luminous horizon; a spreading tree in the distance hints at hospitality. Three-quarter wide view, figures clearly readable, no representation of God as a human figure, no modern buildings, no armor, no ethnic caricatures. Convey a free step of faith and a promise that opens toward all peoples.

prompts.title: Η Μεταμόρφωση: Νόμος, Προφήτες και πλήρωση
prompts.prompt: Create one finished educational theological illustration, widescreen 16:9, mature visual language suitable for Greek secondary education from Gymnasium through final Lyceum. Neo-Byzantine painted illustration: disciplined clear forms, dignified faces, luminous gold and warm earth pigments, deep blue accents, subtle mineral-pigment texture, sophisticated balanced composition. Full bleed, no border, no written words, no labels, no lettering, no watermark. Carefully distinguish all people and limbs. The scene must communicate the specified lesson concept and stand alone at small screen size. Use case: historical-scene with Byzantine iconographic composition. Main request: the Transfiguration of Christ on Mount Tabor, faithful to traditional Orthodox composition. Exactly SIX people total: Christ standing at upper center within a luminous blue-white mandorla, Moses at upper viewer-right holding closed tablets without lettering, Elijah at upper viewer-left; at the lower foreground exactly three apostles, Peter, James and John, reacting in awe, kneeling or prostrate on rocky slopes. Christ in brilliant white robes; radiant light connects the upper and lower registers. Christ's halo contains no letters. Moses and Elijah are distinct dignified elders. Preserve Orthodox theological visual order: Christ is the center and fulfillment of Law and Prophets, prophets stand beside Him, apostles below. Ensure six clearly distinct bodies, two arms and two legs per person, no extra people, no wings, no angel substitutions, no written inscriptions.

Full bleed, no border, no written words, no labels, no lettering, no watermark. Carefully distinguish all people and limbs. Main request: a symbolic learning chamber for the unity and fulfillment of Old and New Testaments. An austere contemplative stone study room, a simple reading table with two distinct ancient rolled scrolls beside one open book. The central objects remain clear in thumbnail, visually communicate preparation and fulfillment belonging to one sacred history.
